## Citations read as symbol names; links to the code are opt-in

Pages now show `CheckoutService.charge` instead of `shop/checkout/service.py::CheckoutService.charge`, and end with a **Checked against the code** box listing every citation in full and the files the page watches.

- `citations: short | full | hidden` in `.indoc/config.yaml` or per page. `hidden` drops parenthesized citations, for partner and customer pages. Checking is unchanged in every style.
- The agent asks whether readers can open the repository before linking to it, and organizes outlines into tutorials, how-tos, reference, and explanation.
- Two pages that would publish at the same URL (`guides.md` next to `guides/index.md`, or a page at `reference/routes.md` next to the generated Routes page) now stop the build instead of one silently replacing the other.

### Upgrading

**Links to the code are now off by default.** Previously, a `source_url` alone made every citation, reference entry, and "Edit this page" link to the repository, which for a private repository meant 404s for most readers. If your readers can open the repository, add:

```yaml
source_links: true
```

Install: `curl -fsSL https://github.com/byabasaija/indoc/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh`, or update the plugin.
